description: This file defines a UI component class 'FilterableSelectList' that combines text input filtering with a selectable list, including filtering logic, rendering, and input handling.

classes.name: FilterableSelectList
classes.description: A UI component that provides a filterable list with input handling and rendering capabilities.

methods.name: applyFilter
methods.description: Filters the list items based on the current filter text.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates the input and list components, likely for re-rendering.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the filter input, separator, and list into an array of strings for display.

methods.name: handleInput
methods.description: Handles user input for navigation, selection, filtering, and cancellation.

methods.name: getSelectedItem
methods.description: Returns the currently selected item in the list.
